page.layout: One page: a table of two columns (Oppidani. | Agrarij.) with a year column at the right, separated by a vertical rule. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom left of centre.
page.notes: Column headers and the year numbers are in old-style figures; years are copied as printed. "Gosen" and "Eusum" are printed with long s, read as plain s. The catchword "Idem" is at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.
